title: Parkour Runner with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a Three.js parkour runner game featuring time manipulation mechanics. Load the 'stork.glb' model using GLTFLoader from CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/) as the player character.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera(70, aspect, 0.1, 1000) positioned at (0, 5, 10) looking forward along -Z.
- Add a DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.5) at (5, 15, 10) and AmbientLight(0x404060, 0.6).
- Create a ground plane (200 x 4 units, green-gray color 0x556655) at y=0 extending along -Z.
- Generate procedural platforms: at least 15 floating platforms (BoxGeometry, various sizes 2-5 wide, 0.3 tall, 2-4 deep) placed at varying heights (y: 1-8) and Z positions (z: -10 to -180), colored with alternating 0x8866aa and 0x66aa88.
- Add red obstacle boxes (1x2x1, color 0xff2222) on the ground and some platforms — at least 8 obstacles total.
- Add collectible coins: yellow spheres (radius 0.3, color 0xffdd00, emissive 0xffaa00) floating and slowly rotating, at least 10 coins scattered across the course.
- Load stork.glb and scale it to roughly 1.5 units tall. Position at (0, 1, 0) as the player character. If the model has animations, play the first one.

PHYSICS & MOVEMENT:
- Implement simple physics: gravity = -20 units/s², player velocity tracking.
- Player moves forward automatically at a base speed of 8 units/s along -Z.
- Left/Right arrow keys move the player laterally (X axis) at 6 units/s, clamped to X range [-3, 3].
- Space bar makes the player jump with initial upward velocity of 12 units/s. Only allow jumping when grounded (on ground plane or on a platform).
- Player lands on platforms if falling onto them from above (simple AABB collision).
- Coin collection: when player is within 1.5 units of a coin center, collect it (hide it, increment score).
- Obstacle collision: if player AABB overlaps an obstacle, trigger a hit (lose 1 life, brief invincibility of 2 seconds, player flashes).

TIME CONTROL MECHANICS:
- Press 'T' key to toggle SLOW MOTION: time scale becomes 0.25x (everything moves at quarter speed). This drains a 'time energy' bar.
- Time energy starts at 100, drains at 40/s while slow-mo is active, recharges at 10/s when not active, capped at 0-100.
- When time energy hits 0, slow motion automatically deactivates.
- Press 'R' key to activate REWIND: reverses the last 3 seconds of movement. Store position snapshots every 0.1s. During rewind, player moves backward through stored positions over 1.5 real seconds. Rewind costs 50 time energy. Cannot rewind if energy < 50.
- Press 'F' key to activate TIME FREEZE: freezes all obstacles and platforms in place for 3 seconds (they stop any movement patterns). Costs 30 time energy.

HUD / UI:
- Top-left: 'Score: X' showing coins collected (white text, 24px, id='hud-score').
- Top-right: 'Lives: X' starting at 3 (red text, 24px, id='hud-lives').
- Top-center: 'Distance: Xm' showing distance traveled in meters (id='hud-distance').
- Below distance: Time energy bar (id='hud-energy-bar') — a div 200px wide, height 20px, with inner fill div (id='hud-energy-fill') colored 0x00ccff, width proportional to energy percentage.
- Center screen: 'Time Mode: NORMAL' / 'SLOW-MO' / 'REWIND' / 'FREEZE' indicator (id='hud-time-mode').
- On game over (lives=0): show overlay div (id='game-over-overlay') with 'GAME OVER' text and final score. Display: none initially.
- A 'Restart' button (id='btn-restart') inside the overlay that resets everything.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
- playerX: number (player X position)
- playerY: number (player Y position)
- playerZ: number (player Z position)
- velocityY: number (vertical velocity)
- isGrounded: boolean
- score: number (coins collected)
- lives: number (remaining lives)
- distance: number (distance traveled in units)
- timeScale: number (current time scale, 1.0 normal, 0.25 slow-mo)
- timeEnergy: number (0-100)
- timeMode: string ('NORMAL', 'SLOW_MO', 'REWIND', 'FREEZE')
- isInvincible: boolean
- coinsTotal: number (total coins in level)
- obstaclesTotal: number (total obstacles)
- gameOver: boolean
- gameStarted: boolean (true after first frame)
- modelLoaded: boolean (true when stork.glb loaded)
- platformCount: number (number of platforms generated)
- rewindAvailable: boolean (true if energy >= 50 and snapshots exist)
- freezeActive: boolean
physics_constraints: Gravity = -20 units/s². Jump velocity = 12 units/s. Base forward speed = 8 units/s (affected by timeScale). Lateral speed = 6 units/s. Player X clamped to [-3, 3]. Time energy: drains 40/s in slow-mo, recharges 10/s normally, capped [0, 100]. Rewind cost = 50 energy. Freeze cost = 30 energy, duration = 3s. Coin collection radius = 1.5 units. Invincibility duration = 2s after hit.
